why_provided: Compress the Marcus/Jake/Lina/platform/client/exit dependency loop into gates Step 6 can preserve before term negotiation.
source_grounding: Marcus drives about 40% of technical capability, may affect Jake and Lina retention, and built the platform prototype; current shape keeps intermediate instruments and a 90-day sprint live.
contribution: Frame the decision as dependency-system design rather than immediate package pricing.
hard_boundary: Do not price or grant the full equity/title/board bundle until platform delivery, team continuity, knowledge transfer, client delivery, governance behavior, and exit story have observable sprint evidence.
relaxation_condition: Relax only if staged evidence shows Marcus increases enterprise capability while reducing single-person concentration.
discard_condition: Discard if Step 6 already includes a concrete dependency map with measurable gates for platform, team, knowledge, governance, and exit effects.
relation_to_bundle: Treat 15% equity, CTO title, and board seat as one leverage bundle whose risk changes after dependency-reduction evidence.
risk_if_forced: Immediate concession may convert dependency into permanent structural veto power.
risk_if_ignored: A vague delay or refusal may trigger Marcus disengagement plus Jake/Lina/platform/client continuity risk.
